name: memory-hygiene
description: Scheduled clean-up of Claude Code auto memory: verify, fix, merge and prune memories and keep MEMORY.md a short index (weekly by default; daily, monthly, per session or after compaction)

schedule.title: Memory clean-up schedule
schedule.description: When a memory clean-up pass is due: weekly (default), daily, monthly, session-start (every new or cleared session), session-end (runs at the next session start), compact (after each compaction), or off.

mode.title: When a pass is due
mode.description: auto (default): Claude runs the clean-up in a background subagent. remind: only show you a reminder, with no model cost.
